details.description: Qwen3-1.7B is a 1.7-billion-parameter (1.4B non-embedding) dense language model from Alibaba's Qwen team, released in April 2025 as part of the Qwen3 family. It switches between a thinking mode for step-by-step reasoning on math, coding and logic tasks and a non-thinking mode for fast, general dialogue within a single model, and supports tool calling and agentic workflows through the Qwen-Agent framework. This deployment lists a 131,072-token context window and is multilingual.
advantages: Switches between an explicit thinking mode and a fast non-thinking mode within a single model, controllable via an enable_thinking parameter (Qwen3-1.7B model card).
Supports tool calling and MCP-based agentic workflows via the Qwen-Agent framework (Qwen3-1.7B model card).
Qwen states Qwen3 models support over 119 languages and dialects (Qwen3 launch blog).
disadvantages: At 1.7B parameters, it is among the smaller models in the Qwen3 dense lineup (0.6B-32B, plus larger mixture-of-experts models), with less reasoning capacity than its larger siblings (Qwen3 GitHub repository).
use_cases: Lightweight general-purpose chat and instruction following
Step-by-step reasoning for math, coding, and logic via thinking mode

sources.title: Qwen3: Think Deeper, Act Faster - Qwen blog

notes: Qwen's own Qwen3-1.7B model card states only a native context length of 32,768 tokens, with no YaRN or other extension documented for this size; the catalog facts and Fireworks' host page both instead list a much larger 131,072-token window for this deployment. Kept the catalog's 131,072 value per instructions but flagged the sizeable gap from the maker's stated figure. The Qwen3 launch blog's statement that 'Qwen3-1.7B-Base performs as well as Qwen2.5-3B-Base' is a Base-checkpoint comparison, not for this post-trained instruct/hybrid model, so it was left out of advantages. Languages: blog gives only a count ('119 languages and dialects'), so the languages list is left empty and the count is in the description instead. No numeric instruct-level benchmark scores for Qwen3-1.7B were found on its model card, the launch blog, or the GitHub README, so evaluations is left empty.
